title: Authentication vs authorization
explain: Authn proves who you are; authz decides what you may do. 401 vs 403 diagnosis depends on this split. (Tier 1–2 simulation fidelity — verify production details in official SAP docs.)
analogy: Think of "Authentication vs authorization" as a named building block you must explain under pressure.
whyItMatters: Without Authentication vs authorization, you mis-diagnose incidents and make weak architecture choices.
commonMistakes: Memorizing the name of Authentication vs authorization without a failure story
howToApply: Use Authentication vs authorization explicitly in a design defense sentence
mnemonic: WHO then WHAT: Authn proves who; Authz decides what. Login ≠ permission.
useCases: Fiori app calls CAP and gets 401 after login — apply Authentication vs authorization to fix the trust chain.
Incident bridge: symptoms appear; use “Authentication vs authorization” to classify the failing hop before changing config.
Architecture review board: defend why you accepted residual risk around “Authentication vs authorization”.
